subject: Security tabletop: telemetry gaps & request for SOC 2 / SIG artifacts
messages:
From: Patricia Cole <patricia.cole@acadiahealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up from today's tabletop — telemetry gaps and next steps

Jonas / Marissa / Karthik,

Thanks for running the tabletop with our ops and security teams this morning — that was helpful. We've attached a short recap (acadia-tabletop-report.pdf) showing the timeline and the two telemetry gaps our compliance team flagged:

- Missing per-tenant request identifiers between 02:14–02:54 UTC on 2026-11-18
- Truncated X-Request-Chain headers in a subset of edge logs

Our SOC 2 reviewer has asked for the following in order to complete the control mapping:

1) A copy of Redwood's current Incident Response Plan (redacted if needed) and the post-incident timeline template you use.
2) Sample telemetry extracts showing how you retain request headers and traces for at least 90 days (redacted for PHI).
3) SIG/CAIQ responses for the technical controls related to logging and monitoring (or a pointer to where we can pull those).

Can you confirm what you can share and an ETA? We can put a secure transfer in place for any artifacts.

Patricia
Security & Compliance, AcadiaHealth

Attachments: acadia-tabletop-report.pdf (pdf, 210KB)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Patricia Cole <patricia.cole@acadiahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's tabletop — telemetry gaps and next steps

Patricia — thanks for the summary and for surfacing the precise asks. We can absolutely help. High-level plan and immediate deliverables: 

- Incident Response Plan: I'll attach a service-level IR summary (redwood-irp-summary.docx) suitable for SOC 2 reviewers; it excludes customer-identifying detail. If you require full runbooks with playbook screenshots, that'll need an NDA supplement — let us know.
- Telemetry extract: we will produce a redacted sample CSV showing request identifiers and X-Request-Chain retention for the 90-day window. Expect the sample by EOD Thursday (2026-12-03).
- SIG / CAIQ: we host an up-to-date SIG/CAIQ pack; I'll link the specific controls for logging/monitoring in my next message and include the control references so they can be mapped.

Proposed timeline:
- 2026-12-03: deliver redacted telemetry sample + IR summary (attachments).
- 2026-12-06: follow-up walkthrough with your SOC reviewer (30 minutes).

Small ask: can you confirm the level of redaction your auditor requires (anonymize tenant IDs vs completely remove IDs)? That will affect the sample.

I'll start a secure SFTP upload and share links here.

— Jonas
Director, Security Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-irp-summary.docx (docx, 85KB)
From: Patricia Cole <patricia.cole@acadiahealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Team <legal@acadiahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's tabletop — telemetry gaps and next steps

Thanks, Jonas — that timeline works for us. A couple of clarifying points from our auditor:

- Redaction: they prefer pseudonymization (replace tenant IDs with consistent hashes) so the sequence/ordering is preserved for control testing.
- Evidence format: CSV or Parquet is fine; CSV is preferred for quick inspection.
- SIG/CAIQ: if you can annotate which controls specifically address detection latency and retention, that'll speed things up.

Also, our legal team asked whether you require a data processing addendum before we share SFTP credentials. Legal copied in — they may send a short template for signatures.

Patricia

Attachment: none
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Patricia Cole <patricia.cole@acadiahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's tabletop — telemetry gaps and next steps

Patricia — short update and links:  

1) Uploaded artifacts to a time-limited secure folder (link below). Contents: redwood-irp-summary.docx, evidence-202611-logs.zip (redacted and pseudonymized), telemetry-sample-redacted.csv, and a CSV mapping file that shows which SIG/CAIQ control rows map to detection & retention (ControlMap-SIG-Logging.csv).

Secure folder (expires 2026-12-10): https://drive.redwood.com/s/acadia/IRP-Summary-78421

2) We do not require an additional DPA to accept SFTP creds for this evidence transfer; however, if your legal team prefers DocuSign for the supplemental confidentiality addendum they sent, we can sign it.

3) Proposed walkthrough: Mon 2026-12-06 14:00–14:30 PT — would you and/or your SOC lead be available? We'll have Karthik (for telemetry mapping) and Marissa (for IR process) on the call.

Next steps: if you approve the folder access, I'll share a short readout PDF in the drive and drop the HubSpot activity (deal D-78421). If you prefer the SFTP path, send account/user and we'll pull the artifacts there.

Thanks — appreciating the quick turnaround from your side.

— Jonas
Director, Security Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence-202611-logs.zip (zip, 26MB); telemetry-sample-redacted.csv (csv, 120KB); ControlMap-SIG-Logging.csv (csv, 6KB)
